description: Bucket taxonomy for expensive-review findings (case_6bf2cca9 feedback loop). Every finding from an expensive (Tier-2) review is labelled with the bucket that should have caught it. A bucket seen 3+ times in 90 days becomes a Semgrep/lint rule or a Tier-1 prompt.

buckets.meaning: A Semgrep/custom rule should have flagged it
An existing linter/parser check should have flagged it
A repo test (validators, authz matrix, EXPLAIN scan) should have failed
Docs-vs-diff check: a changed doc section is no longer true of the code
Correctly needed the expensive reviewer (large-diff emergent issue)
Does not fit above; triage decides the real bucket

promotion_rule: A non-Tier-2 bucket (tier0-*, tier1-*) reaching 3 findings in 90 days must become a Semgrep/lint rule or a Tier-1 prompt update on the same card that reports it. Tier-2 buckets (security-boundary, size-complexity) confirm routing is working and need no promotion.
